title: A learned procedure climbs to trusted on its own evidence and serves a goal with no model and no app
description: The app is the proving suite's FIXTURE APP: a fake harness that performs the goal's actions on the fake machine and reports each one as the cockpit does, through the same session writer a delegated app session is recorded through. It is not a provider and plays no cassette; every session it runs counts as one model reach, because an app session is the intelligence a learned procedure exists to stop paying for. Two recordings with two bindings are lifted into a procedure; two goals with two new bindings are served by the app with the procedure compared beside it in a sandbox (m=2 matches across k=2 bindings); a person approves the one promotion through the work spine's own decide handler; one canary replay makes it trusted; and the measured goal is served by the trusted replay alone. The ladder is the platform's own at every goal: the scenario never says which rung serves.
goal: Reconcile the weekly ledger for {{account}} and notify the operators
